common: Use case: stylized-concept. One EMPTY landscape background for a narrative anime RPG, 16:9 2560x1440 PNG, no characters, no people, no text or UI. Fine painterly cel-art matching Memory Forge: night workshop, brass instruments, stopped clocks, dark calm atmosphere, small teal memory lights, character overlays must stay brightest.
pose: Quiet cobbled guild passage after a battle, paper scraps settled near walls and a few cooled brass mechanical fragments at edges, absolutely no bodies or blood. Warm workshop windows beyond an arch and a stopped brass clock mounted to stone. Spacious uncomplicated central foreground to stage two adults, horizon midheight, muted cool slate and restrained amber teal.
